name: Drawer
description: A slide-in panel with its own trigger button — mobile navigation, filters, a cart — built on the native popover API.
whenToUse: Mobile navigation menus, filter panels, side carts: anywhere the user asks for a hamburger menu, a slide-out, an off-canvas panel or a drawer. USE THIS INSTEAD OF useState PLUS AN OUTSIDE-CLICK LISTENER: the native popover gives top-layer stacking, click-outside and Escape dismissal, focus handling and a backdrop with ZERO JavaScript, so the section publishes static and still works with JS disabled. Give each drawer on a page a unique `id`. NOT for a centred modal dialog (use Dialog) and NOT for content that should always be visible on desktop — render a normal nav at wider breakpoints and this only on small screens.
